blurb: Guests cruise along the Lake Erie shoreline for city views, sunsets, swimming near the intake crib, and special events. The boat is a large cruiser with amenities including a full galley, hot shower, pump toilet, and refrigerator. The captain and crew handle all sailing operations; guests relax and enjoy the experience.
